description: This file defines a static class ConfigureCoreServices with an extension method AddCoreServices for IServiceCollection. It registers various application core services, repositories, logging, and configurations in an ASP.NET Core dependency injection container.

classes.name: ConfigureCoreServices
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to configure core services within dependency injection.

methods.name: AddCoreServices
methods.description: Extension method that registers core application services, repositories, logging, and configuration settings in the DI container.
